name: dcode-agent-kit
description: Skill/plugin scaffolding kit with embedded templates and version-scoped guidance for Deep Agents SDK programs and dcode agent identities, using environment-configured model connectors.

metadata.github_description: A Claude Code skill that scaffolds ready-to-run LangChain Deep Agents and dcode CLI agents into any project.

SKILL.lean_review_note: Full nine-file tree: one scaffolding skill, plugin/marketplace packaging and a version-scoped integration guide. Substantial embedded model-connector and SDK-agent scaffolds are independently reusable templates, not installed Python modules or a bundled Deep Agents framework. Images and duplicate packaging instructions are excluded.

deep_review.conclusion: The public tree contains instructions and code templates, not a running permission service. Connector templates read credentials from environment/.env and can send them to a configured provider URL; use only trusted endpoints and protect those files. Mutating template examples pair interrupt_on with a checkpointer and show a gate-verification procedure, but those library semantics and the generated smoke tests were not executed here. Tool examples are stubs; host permissions, real implementations and persistent production checkpointing require integration review.
